svg.text: k cache-write tokens per distinct held (filled: the Opus 5.5 referee, hollow: the Fable referee); '▸ ceiling' marks a cell whose cost note calls the whole arm's figure a ceiling
dollars at right: as billed, the earlier figure in parentheses; a hatched POOLED box is one bill over the cells it names, not apportioned; 9 cells have no per-cell bill
dollars are whole-arm bills (reader and its own skeptic together) where a bill exists
